note: Defaults for /finance. kind is 'sourced' (public number, link and date given) or 'assumption' (our placeholder, edit it). Base Power's real financing terms are not public.

fields.label: Installed cost
fields.note: Midpoint of Base's own "landed cost of storage" range, about $300 to $400 per kWh.

fields.label: Member pays up front
fields.note: "Whole home backup for only $695 and then $19/mo." Treated as cash that lowers what must be financed.

fields.label: Member fee
fields.note: Same page. We assume every member pays every month (no churn).

fields.label: Utility toll or capacity payment
fields.note: Placeholder: $60/kW-year is $5 per kW-month. Base says it can toll batteries to a utility, but no price is public. ERCOT has no capacity market, so this would be a private contract.

fields.label: Availability
fields.note: Base reports "96% fleet availability". Applied to the toll and to arbitrage (pay for performance).

fields.label: Retail energy margin
fields.note: Any margin on selling electricity to members is not public. Default $0, so the model does not lean on it. Raise it to test.

fields.label: Operating cost
fields.note: Placeholder for monitoring, insurance, service visits, software and support. Not public.

fields.label: Capacity fade
fields.note: Cuts toll and arbitrage value each year. Member fees do not fade.

fields.label: Useful life
fields.note: Typical range 10 to 15 years. The loan cannot run longer than this.

fields.label: Interest rate
fields.note: Placeholder all-in cost of debt. No public Base debt terms were found (search on 2026-10-30).

fields.label: Loan term
fields.note: Level payments, paid off in full by the end of the term.

fields.label: Target DSCR
fields.note: Debt service coverage ratio. Cash flow must be at least this many times the loan payment in the weakest year.

fields.label: Advance rate cap
fields.note: The most a lender will lend against the installed cost, whatever the cash flow.

fields.label: Number of batteries
fields.note: Stand-in: Base's public "Loved by 30,000+ Texans" member count. Base has not said how many batteries are installed.
